title: Locations of the Pup, Ritz, Haymarket and Lavida
summary: He sorts out the dance halls on Iberville Street and the Lavida on Burgundy.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: This Ritz or the Puppe, where was that exact?

On Iberville between Burgundy and Ramport. Right where the fern dance hall was. Right where the fern was. That's the same building. There was two, there was two right together, one right next to each other, you see. The Puppe was the first one, the Puppe was where the fern was. And next to that was the Haymarket, which later become the Lavia. That's where Collins played, you know. Lee Collins, that's where he played. Tony Perranti, I believe. Well no, that's another Lavia. The Lavia that Tony Perranti played, it was on Burgundy between Canal and Iberville. See, and this is on Iberville between Burgundy and Ramport. The Lavia that Tony Perranti played was a high class nightclub. And the other one was a dive. It was really like I tell you, it was the Puppe and the Haymarket Cabaret. And then they later called it, it was the Dime Dance Hall, right next to the fern. Well when they first called it the Lavia, it wasn't the, because I played in there with Max Fink, who was a fiddle player around here. I played in there with him. They called it the Lavia. But later they made a Dime Dance Hall out of it and that's where Lee Collins, that's the first time I ever heard Lee Collins in my life he played right in there. And then they had a, oh they had a Rapp and Skaglione and them played in there when it was Oasis. But the Oitchka Cadillac and that, that's two different, I mean the Levita, the both of them, that's two different things. One was on Burgundy Street and the other one was on Iberville Street.
